DIV8.HEAD: § 1.162-1 Business expenses.
DIV8.P: Business expenses deductible from gross income include the ordinary and necessary expenditures directly connected with or pertaining to the taxpayer's trade or business.
Double deductions are not permitted. Amounts deducted under one provision of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 cannot again be deducted under any other provision thereof.

DIV8.HEAD: § 1.274-12 Limitation on food or beverage expenses.
DIV8.P: A deduction is allowed for food or beverage expenses only if the expense is not lavish or extravagant under the circumstances and the taxpayer, or an employee of the taxpayer, is present at the furnishing of such food or beverages.
